name: source-snapshot-admission
goal: Archived source reads retain indexed files and gaps without invoking caller array iterators

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Replacing archived-source lookup with array spread can discard snapshots when an admitted in-memory array supplies a different iterator.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard Source admission case checked rendering only; extend the same case through the public archivedSource file-read entry with indexed snapshots and explicit gaps.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable 2aec84ce071c56df56a6e7b2370f64cfaf9921b2886f9c4bca3b156c16e725bd reproduces discarded indexed snapshots through the standard Source admission case at719940966.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Copy both archived source collections by indexed access before reading; preserve recorded empty collections and explicit gaps without caller iteration or species.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
